'''Tub tim krob''' (Thai: ทับทิมกรอบ)<ref>{{cite web|title=Red Rubies|url=http://www.thelittleteochew.com/2009/08/red-rubies-tub-tim-krob.html|website=Thelittleteochew|accessdate=2 September 2014}}</ref> is one of the most famous Thai [[Cookbook:Dessert|desserts]]. It is made of cubes of water chestnuts coated with red food coloring. This dessert is also known as “Red Rubies” because its appearance looks similar to bright red rubies. It is usually eaten with coconut milk and ice cubes, which makes it very tasty and refreshing. It is a perfect Thai dessert to eat after a hot and spicy Thai meal. There are several methods of making Tub Tim Krob, but the most basic version below takes only five steps to make.<ref>{{cite web |title=Tub Tim Krob Recipe |url=http://www.thaitable.com/thai/recipe/rubies-in-coconut-milk |accessdate=2 September 2014 |website=Thaitable}}</ref> 

== Ingredients == 
There are five main ingredients for this dessert.<ref>{{cite web|title=Tub Tim Krob|url=http://amazingthaifood.tourismthailand.org/thai-food/food-details/d5/|website=Amazingthaifood|publisher=Amazingthaifood|accessdate=2 September 2014}}</ref>
* ⅓ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Coconut Milk|coconut milk]]
* 5 drops red [[Cookbook:Food Coloring|food coloring]]
* ½ cup [[Cookbook:Tapioca Starch|tapioca flour]]
* ¼ cup water
* ½ can whole [[Cookbook:Water Chestnut|water chestnuts]]

== Procedure ==
# Peel and cut the water chestnuts into small cubes.
# Soak the water chestnut cubes in red food coloring until their color changes to red.
# Mix the colored water chestnut cubes with tapioca flour until the skin of the cubes is covered with the flour.
# [[Cookbook:Boiling|Boil]] them in hot water for several minutes or until the water chestnut cubes float to the top of the water.
# Mix the water chestnut cubes with coconut milk and serve with ice cubes in a bowl.
